environment.description: Rails 7.1 API application deployed on EC2 behind an AWS ALB with no request validation. ALB performs TLS termination and forwards all requests directly to the Rails application on port 3000. Authentication is handled solely by the application-level token check. No additional middleware or gateway sits between the ALB and the application.

config.alb_rules: Default forward rule to target group
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL with sequential integer primary keys
